cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. No source found since October 2023 says land can be searched or registered online.
cells.note: A July 2026 review of the land reforms says 1.5 million parcels in Bamako, Kati and several towns hold a unique cadastral number, and the digitised-documents module runs at the Bamako and Kati land offices. Nothing says it covers the country, so not 4.
